notes.title: Patch v0.69.3
notes.content: [p]Hello fans! Thank you so much for the continuous support![/p][p][/p][p]We received more feedback from you guys, so we immediately started working on them.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]Stella Magical Idol v0.69.3[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]Minor fixes[/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug that prevented the windowed fullscreen to be set as the window mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a problem with the second sex scene where the SFX and moaning would stop.[/p][/*][/list][p]QOL changes[/p][list][*][p]Changed the default volume for the sex SFX and the moanings from 10 to 50.[/p][/*][*][p]The reset save file button on the settings (when accessed from the main menu) now doesn't reset the story mode tutorials flags.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed hints to solutions and reworked the scene solutions's text, it now describes clearly what you need to do to solve the puzzle.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]TYSM for all the support ❤️❤️❤️ it means the world to us. We hope to keep reading more of your feedback, and thank you a lot for taking the time to fill the survey![/p][p][/p][p]See you on the stage or maybe being attacked by a big bad Kaiju.[/p]

notes.title: Patch v0.69.2
notes.content: [p]Hello fans! Thank you so much for the continuous support![/p][p][/p][p]We received more reports of bugs and some QOL feedback, so we immediately worked on them.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]Stella Magical Idol v0.69.2[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]Minor fixes[/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where you skipped dialogue so fast on the dating app minigame dialogue that it would cause an empty white placeholder and empty text, this would prevent the sex scene to appear.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the mouse cursor would sometimes change when entering the dating app mini game.[/p][/*][/list][p]QOL changes[/p][list][*][p]Left click and space bar now both makes all the dialogue appear and makes the next dialogue to start (previously you needed to left click to make all the dialogue appear and use space bar to go to the next dialogue).[/p][/*][*][p]Main menu tutorial dialogues reduced from 8 lines to 5.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]TYSM for all the support it means the world to us. We hope to keep reading more of your feedback, see you on the stage or maybe being attacked by a big bad Kaiju.[/p]

notes.title: Stella Magical Idol DEMO OUT NOW!!!
notes.content: [p]Hello fans!!! We are really pleased to announce that our [b]demo[/b] for [b]Stella Magical Idol[/b] is finally out, it's been a long way with ups and downs but we hope that you like the demo and any feedback would be appreciated. [/p][p][/p][p]Also if you like our game and you haven't wishlisted it by now, it would mean the world to us if you gave it a wishlist and if you know someone that would enjoy this kind of game, spread the love please! <3[/p][p][/p][p]At the end of the demo the game will show you a small thank you message from the DuraznitoGames team and a button that takes you to a survey, if you could give us 3-5 more minutes of your time we would be really grateful and improve the game with the survey results.[/p][p][/p][p]We will continue to work in the next chapters of the story towards the 1.0 release late Q3 or early Q4, and also keep an eye on the feedback for any bug that might appear and fix it as soon as possible.[/p][p][/p][p][i]Here is a peak of three scenes from the game, one of them is not on the game, so you will have to wait a little bit to be able to see the intense scene between [b]Stella[/b] and her boss [b]Queen[/b].[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45667830/27b6d9045ffd7c41fecb19c18d8073f507c29808.png"][/img][/p][p][i]And last but not least here is a message from our lovely and sexy Magical Idol, Stella.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45667830/500d48a3298152ff406a890d777a8bdc73974a9b.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Patch v0.69.1
notes.content: [p]Hello fans! Thank you so much for everyone that has been playing our demo, you rock![/p][p][/p][p]We received reports of a couple of bugs and immediately worked on them.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]Stella Magical Idol v0.69.1[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]Minor fixes[/p][list][*][p]Fixed the visual bug in the settings window (The combo boxes, checkbox and sliders where misaligned)[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the way the game handles the background music (It was causing in some specific cases to play multiple times the same song)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]PS: We will keep on developing the next chapters of the game and fixing any bug that you guys report via the demo survey or discussions on the steam forum, TYSM for all the support it means the world to us. See you on the stage or maybe being attacked by a big bad Kaiju.[/p]
